title: Paying Your Fine
introduction: This page tells you some ways you can pay your fine.

blocks.title: Pay your fine online

paragraphs.text: You can use a computer to pay your fine online.
You will need the payment details from your fine.

blocks.imgAlt: A person paying online at a laptop beside a graphic of a bank card

blocks.title: Pay your fine by phone

paragraphs.text: You can call Revenue NSW to pay your fine.

blocks.imgAlt: A woman making a phone call beside a graphic money symbol

blocks.title: After you pay a driving fine

paragraphs.text: Some driving fines can stop you from driving.
Call Service NSW after you pay your fine.
Call 13 77 88 to find out when you can drive.

blocks.imgAlt: A woman calling about a driving fine beside graphics of a car, fine and red cross
